reason: No owner I know and no distributor I deal with uses this, so I won't be the first to try it. My girls work from the register and WhatsApp, and I count the drawer myself every night, so for now that's enough.
objection: It's only in English. My stylists won't type in English on a phone app, and paying ₹4,999 setup for something my own staff won't use is money wasted.
would_change_my_mind: If the app came in Hindi and a salon owner near me showed me it running in her parlour for a few months.
